basics.name: Ben Finkelshtein
basics.summary: Passionate researcher and PhD candidate at the University of Oxford, specializing in Geometric Deep Learning. Supervised by DeepMind Chair of AI Prof. Michael M. Bronstein and Dr. Ismail Ilkan Ceylan. With extensive experience in both academia and industry, I have worked on areas such as natural language processing, anomaly detection, and time series forecasting.

publications.name: Learning on Large Graphs using Intersecting Communities
publications.summary: A new and fundamentally different pipeline for learning on very large non-sparse graphs using intersecting communities.

publications.name: Graph Neural Network Outputs are Almost Surely Asymptotically Constant
publications.summary: A new angle on the expressive power of GNNs by studying  how the predictions of a GNN probabilistic classifier evolve.

publications.name: Cooperative Graph Neural Networks
publications.summary: A more dynamic and flexible message-passing paradigm in which each node can choose a different communication strategy.

publications.name: Strategic Classification with Graphs Neural Networks
publications.summary: Learning in a setting where users that are dependant can modify their features to obtain favorable predictions.

publications.name: A Simple and Universal Rotation Equivariant Point-cloud Network
publications.summary: A simple architecture which is equivariant to rigid motions with the ability to approximate any equivariant function.

publications.name: Single-Node Attack for Fooling Graph Neural Networks
publications.summary: Showcased that GNNs are vulnerable to a realistic single-node adversarial attack, even when the attacker cannot be chosen.

professional experience.name: eBay
professional experience.summary: Engineered large language models (LLMs) to match user queries with the most relevant landing pages for search engine optimization. This involved developing a novel keyword extraction technique, which I integrated with GPT-3 and subsequently fine-tuned for optimal performance. These efforts resulted in a significant improvement in user engagement, achieving a 30% increase in landing page click-through rates (CTR) within the first three months of implementation.

professional experience.name: SKF Group, AI Center of Excellence
professional experience.summary: Designed, customized, and implemented end-to-end machine learning pipelines, taking projects from initial ideation to production. I led research initiatives focused on event prediction, anomaly detection, and time series forecasting to support machinery fault diagnosis. My work included creating an event-based evaluation metric that enhanced the company’s anomaly detection accuracy from 78% to 90%, significantly improving operational reliability.

professional experience.name: Rafael Advanced Defense Systems
professional experience.summary: A specialized military service assignment awarded to only one recruit per year, I created a neural network to predict $n$-body problem solutions for classified company use. Additionally, I engineered generative models to predict molecular dynamics pathways using physical simulations and developed new models to analyze stable and transient protein folding conformations, advancing our understanding of complex biological processes.

teaching experience.name: University of Oxford, Faculty of Computer Science
teaching experience.summary: Head TA for Geometric Deep Learning and Graph Representation Learning courses, responsible over the other TAs, creating coding assignments and guiding 30 students through coursework.

teaching experience.name: Blue Education
teaching experience.summary: Taught Math, Physics, and Computer Science for A-Levels, SAT, and college exams as an online part-time tutor.

teaching experience.name: Technion - Israel Institute of Technology, Faculty of Computer Science
teaching experience.summary: Head TA for the Geometric Deep Learning course, supervising 40 students and developing tutorials and code notebooks for the course.

teaching experience.name: Matematix – High-School and College Exam Preparation Center
teaching experience.summary: Taught Mathematics, Physics, English, and Coding for matriculation, SAT, and college exams, leading sessions of 30 students.
